March 15, 2020

Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement

For release at 5:00 p.m. EDT

In light of these developments, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 0 to 1/4 percent.

Voting against this action was Loretta J. Mester, who preferred to reduce the target range for the federal funds rate to 1/2 to 3/4 percent at this meeting.
